instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the Autodesk EAGLE graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, or any shell; do not run ULP scripts, command-line automation, Python, or other helper scripts/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only EAGLE native GUI tools, menus, and built-in save/export commands. Drill 4 mounting holes (`3.2 mm` unplated through-holes) into `body.brd`, one `5 mm` inset from each corner of the existing `40 x 25 mm` board outline, and save the board as `/home/user/Desktop/answer.brd`. Requirements: 1. `/home/user/Desktop/answer.brd` parses as well-formed XML. 2. The file has exactly 4 `<hole drill='3.2'>` elements inside the `<plain>` block. 3. Those 4 holes are positioned at `(5, 5)`, `(35, 5)`, `(35, 20)`, and `(5, 20)` mm, within `+/- 0.5 mm`. 4. The `<element>` count is unchanged relative to the starter. 5. The 4 original layer-20 outline wires are still present. 6. The mounting holes are unplated and appear as `<hole>` elements, not `<pad>` elements.
